title: eat shit & die 229
author: bpatrick
body: I don’t know why I think this is so funny. I was building a whole short story around it but figured with my pace I’d never get to it. It seems like it’d be the subject of a song from some alt post-punk college band from the 80s: “Now that you’re gone, the world is ending (but only incidentally, baby)”.

comments.author: steve
comments.text: Good to see you’re still making comics, thanks! 😀
